summary: Homeowner in Denver booked a free HVAC inspection for Thursday at 10 AM.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, thanks for calling Summit Home Services. I'm Alex. I can help you schedule a free HVAC efficiency inspection. How can I help today?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yeah, my AC has been running a lot and my bill is higher. I'd like someone to take a look.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I can definitely help with that. First, are you the homeowner, and is the property in the Denver metro area?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, I own the home in Aurora.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Great, Aurora is in our service area. Can I get your full name, phone number, email, and the service address?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Maria Gonzalez. Phone is 303-555-0142. Email maria.g at email dot com. Address is 1420 Elm Street, Aurora, 80012.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you, Maria. I have Thursday at 10 AM or Friday at 1 PM available. Which works better?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Perfect. I've booked your free inspection for Thursday at 10 AM at 1420 Elm Street. You'll get a confirmation text and email. Our technician will review your system efficiency and answer any questions. Anything else I can help with?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You're welcome, Maria. We look forward to seeing you Thursday.
